Join Kuehne+Nagel in Geel as an experienced order picker and earn €16,3753/hour plus €8 meal vouchers working in a 2-shift system!

In this varied role, you will combine active order picking with quality control and warehouse administration. You will ensure top quality for renowned brands like LEGO and make sure every shipment is in perfect condition.

Ready to take the next step in your logistics career? Send your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be or call us directly at 014 24 86 60!

VG 458/BUOSAP

What are we looking for in a candidate?

• Minimum of 6 months to 1 year of experience in a warehouse setting or order picking.
• Proven experience working with a handheld scanner is required.
• Good command of either Dutch or English.
• Willing to work in a 2-shift rotation on a long-term basis.
• Must have your own transport to commute to the site in Geel.

• Order picking goods in the warehouse using a handheld scanner.
• Conducting accurate quality control checks on picked LEGO orders.
• Checking and monitoring physical inventory and stock discrepancies.
• Handling the required warehouse administration within the system.
• Reporting deviations and safeguarding overall quality standards.

Adecco is looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Officer to strengthen the Volvo Action Service team at Volvo Group! 

Help drivers get back on the road quickly and efficiently. As a Breakdown Assistance Call Handler, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and ensure that every driver receives help as quickly as possible. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed at all times.

This is a role with real impact: thanks to your calm approach, strong communication skills, and solution-oriented mindset, you truly make a difference during stressful situations. Your responsibilities: 

 
• Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing a breakdown on the road. 
 

 
• Analyze the problem by assessing the situation and gathering the necessary information. 
 

 
• Organize interventions and dispatch them to breakdown services, partners, or internal technicians. 
 

 
• Follow up on cases from A to Z, ensuring clear and continuous communication with the driver. 
 

 
• Register all relevant information in the system (time, location, nature of the problem, planning, etc.). 
 

 
• Remain calm in emergency situations and always act with a strong customer focus. 
 

 
• Work closely with a dedicated team that is available 24/7 to provide optimal customer support. 

What do we expect from you? 

 
• You have strong communication skills and are able to handle phone calls clearly, empathetically, and professionally. 
 

 
• You are stress-resistant and able to maintain an overview in busy and demanding situations. 
 
•  
Problem-solving comes naturally to you. 

 
•  
You are fluent in English and German (minimum B2 level) and another European Language. 

 
• You are comfortable working with digital tools and handling administrative follow-up. 
 
•  
You are willing to work flexible shifts: early, late, day and weekends — truck drivers are on the road anytime, anywhere. 

 
•  
Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside/mobility assistance is a plus, but not a requirement. 

 
• You hold a bachelor's degree or have relevant equivalent experience. 
 

 
• You have your own means of transportation.

As Communications & Sales Assistant, you will work closely with the Managing Director to support the day-to-day operations of the yoga studio. You will be responsible for customer service, communications, marketing, sales support, event coordination and general administrative tasks. This is a varied role within a small business, requiring excellent organisational skills, initiative and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate enjoys working with people, is highly organised, has strong communication skills and is comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Main Responsibilities

Customer Service

• Respond to client enquiries by email in a professional and timely manner.
• Provide excellent customer service and ensure effective follow-up with prospective and existing clients.
• Manage client records and bookings through the studio's booking software.
Communications

• Update and maintain the studio website.
• Create, schedule and publish content for social media platforms.
• Take photos and videos for marketing and community content.
• Plan, write and distribute newsletters to the studio mailing list.
• Coordinate internal communication with the front desk team and yoga teachers.
Marketing & Sales

• Support marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
• Plan and coordinate sales promotions together with the Managing Director.
• Assist with client retention initiatives and partnership opportunities.
• Use the studio management software to support marketing and sales activities and monitor campaign performance.
Operations & Events

• Coordinate the organisation of workshops, teacher trainings, retreats and community events.
• Assist with the recruitment and onboarding of future team members.
• Support the day-to-day organisation and presentation of the studio.
• Provide general administrative and operational support to the Managing Director as required. 
Education

• Master's degree in Communications, Marketing, Languages, Social Sciences, Business Administration or a related field.
Professional Experience

• Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in a similar position combining communications, customer service, marketing, sales support and administrative coordination.
• Previous experience within a small business or service-oriented organisation is considered a strong asset.
Technical Skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Good command of French is an asset.
• Excellent computer skills and confidence using digital tools, including CRM/booking software, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
• Experience managing websites (CMS), email marketing platforms and social media channels.
• Experience creating digital content, including basic photography and video content for social media.
Personal Skills

• Excellent organisational and planning skills with strong attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritise tasks effectively.
• Proactive, resourceful and capable of working independently.
• Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
• Commercial mindset with an interest in sales and business development.
• Ability to communicate professionally with clients, teachers, partners and suppliers.
• Flexible, reliable and comfortable working in a dynamic small-business environment.
Additional Assets

• Interest in yoga, health and wellbeing.
• Experience in the organisation of events, workshops or training programmes is an asset. 
• Contract: Fixed-term employment contract (CDD), part-time (22.48 hours per week - 60%).
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, according to the agreed work schedule (22.48 hours per week).
• Place of work: The House of Yoga, Rue de la Paix 14, 1050 Ixelles (Brussels).
• Benefits: Free participation in yoga classes at the studio, subject to availability.
• Professional development: Opportunity to develop a broad range of skills across communications, marketing, sales, customer service and business operations within a growing small business.
• Career prospects: The position is initially offered as a fixed-term contract, with the intention of extending the collaboration and the possibility of a permanent contract based on performance and the company's future needs.

Job description
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you will be working closely with local HSE teams and business leaders, you will develop policies, strengthen governance, promote best practices and help create a strong safety culture throughout the organisation. 
 

· You will develop, maintain and continuously improve the Group HSE Management System; define, implement and harmonise HSE policies, standards and procedures across all business entities. 
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you ensure alignment with local legislation while maintaining a common Group HSE framework, you’ll coordinate the implementation of governance processes in different regions across Europe. 
 

· You will lead corporate HSE initiatives and continuous improvement programmes, and drive the development of a proactive safety culture across the organisation. 
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you will monitor changes in European and local HSE legislation and translate these into Group policies, and support senior leadership by providing strategic HSE advice and reporting.

Your profile 
 

· 
 You obtained a Master Degree in a related discipline, or equivalent by experience. 
 

· 
 You have relevant expertise with HSE Governance & Policy within an industrial, infrastructure, engineering or renewable energy environment.
 

· 
 Proven experience in developing HSE management systems, governance frameworks and corporate policies.

 Analytical, structured and able to translate strategy into practical policies. 
 

· 
 Strong knowledge of English, and Dutch and/or French.

● 
 You have relevant experience in project management, preferably 
in Hydrogen, Renewable Energy or similar industries.

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware compute systems.
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

We are looking for a Virtual Platform R&D Engineer to develop, enable, and maintain our baseline platform across functional models, RTL prototyping, and simulation environments. This role sits at the intersection of compute architecture, system software, and system modeling. 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Develop and maintain virtual platforms across both simulated, and hardware-prototyping environments. 

• Support workload mapping and enable functional models bring-up on various execution platforms such as: QEMU, gem5, RTL, FGPA. 

• Contribute to performance and functional validation across abstraction levels (ISA → RTL → FPGA). 

• Build system models that represent novel compute architectures, while balancing accuracy, execution speed, and ease of use. 

• Evaluate new architectural features, translating architectural concepts into executable platforms. 

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in cooperation with senior members, if needed.  

• Supervise or assist in mentoring students when necessary.  

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or other relevant domains with hands-on compute architecture systems.   

• You are passionate about computer architecture and system-level design, with a solid understanding of modern compute and memory systems, and SoC components.  

• You have a strong background in embedded systems, including toolchains (GCC/LLVM), RTOS (e.g., Zephyr), and low-level debugging.  

• You are proficient in C/C++, in bash and Python scripting.  

• You are a hands-on engineer who enjoys bringing systems to life.  

• You have experience in RISC-V-based system architecture.   

• You are open-minded, and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs.   

• You are a team player, as you will be part of a dynamic and distributed team.  

• You are fluent in English and you have strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across a multicultural team.

Job description
 

● As a Business Developer – Renewable Energy you‘ll be identifying, initiating and developing large & innovative Solar, Wind, EV charging infrastructure, Energy Management System (EMS) and BESS projects.
 

● You’ll be creating a business development plan for the Renewable Energy strategy and be enlarging your contact list with potential clients using leads, your personal network and prospection.
 

● As a Business Developer – Renewable Energy you’ll be educating clients on the features and technical specifications; you’ll be formulating a business plan that benefit both the clients and the organization. You’re always aiming for win-win outcomes.
 

● You’ll be securing renewable installation and infrastructure projects: contracts for installing innovative hybrid Wind turbines, large Solar installations on rooftops or ground-mounted systems, EV charging projects, BESS, Energy Management System (EMS) projects, etc.
 

● As a Business Developer – Renewable Energy you act as the primary contact for local and regional stakeholders; you’ll identify growth possibilities and propose ideas for hybrid Solar, Wind, EV charging installations, Energy Management System (EMS) and BESS opportunities.
 

● You’ll be building partnerships with multiple stakeholders to increase visibility and lead generation, you’ll participating in internal meetings with the business development and project management teams.

Your profile 
 

●You have a Master or Bachelor degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, etc. or an equivalent level of education. 
 

●You have commercial aptitude and relevant experience in B2B prospecting, contract negotiation and similar domains. 
 

●You are passionate about Renewable Energy and/or environmental technologies. 
 

●Good knowledge of English and are able to communicate in Dutch and/ or French. 
 

●You are communicative, have strong people skills and solution selling skills.

Our sector specialists understand the needs of customers perfectly and guide them along the way with advice and support. Aiming for results for multinationals, SMEs, self-employed persons and private persons is what makes our blood flow. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) to join our team in Vilvoorde.

Ready to level up your career and secure the digital world? As a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) you’ll be the go-to expert managing our network and security infrastructure – across our campus, datacenter, and Microsoft Azure environment.

What will you do?

• Take charge of our network & security landscape, both on-prem and in the cloud (Azure).
• Provide Level 2 support for complex IT network issues.
• Dive into IT projects related to your area of expertise.
• Work autonomously in an agile setup with a clear backlog and strategic focus.
• Help improve documentation and technical guidelines.
• Detect, assess, and fix security risks – you're our digital guardian.
• Manage and fine-tune spam filters to keep our communications safe.

Experience:

• You've already rolled up your sleeves in network and firewall management — think design, setup, config, upgrades — and you know your way around operational environments.
• You’re certified in Azure, have experience with it, or you're eager to dive in and grow into a true Azure pro.
• You’re ready to become our in-house expert on Microsoft Security tools — managing, fine-tuning, and pushing them to keep cyber threats out.
• You're curious about Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and see it as a powerful tool in building fast, scalable, modern environments.
• You believe solid processes are the backbone of great IT — and you embrace ITIL best practices to keep things running smoothly and smartly.
• You hold an IT bachelor degree and have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the following domains:
• Routing & Switching: Aruba and / or Cisco
• Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) : Fortinet, Check Point or Palo Alto
• Reverse Proxy : BlueCoat, Fortiweb or Azure Application GW
• SASE/SDWAN: CATO, Fortinet, zScaler or Pallo Alto
• Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) CATO and / or zScaler
• Cloud Networking & Security: Azure 
• Network Access Control (802.1X Wired/Wireless, RADIUS, TACACS, Guest Portals)
• Vulnerability management: Nessus, MS Defender or Qualys
• Network Detection and Response (NDR): Darktrace 
• Extended Detection and Response (XDR): MS Defender and / or Sentinelone, 
• Spam filtering: MS Defender, Barracuda or Cisco Ironport 

Personality:

• You don’t wait around — when something’s blocking the business, you jump in and fix it fast.
• You’re all about progress: positive mindset, always learning, always improving, and staying sharp on the latest tech trends.
• Agile is your jam — you thrive in sprints, love a good retro, and believe great things happen when teams grow together.
 

Languages:

• Dutch or French? Check. English? No problem — you’re fluent in the language of international teamwork.
